# Horse Race Checklist

## Players

- At least two players can participate.
- Every player has exactly one horse.
- Every player has exactly one lane.
- Player names are visible.

## Race

- Start Race starts all horses.
- Every horse moves.
- Horse movement is randomized.
- Every horse reaches the finish line.
- Every horse finishes exactly once.

## Classification

- Classification waits for all horses.
- Classification contains all players.
- Every player appears exactly once.
- Positions start at 1.
- Order matches the finishing order.

## Technical

- Application remains standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
- JavaScript follows applicable workspace instructions.
- App/script.js passes node --check.
